mapper.select: SELECT rp.`id`, rp.`activity_id`, rp.`title`, rp.`sub_title`, rp.`rules`, rp.`pay_value`, rp.`actual_value`, rp.`type`, quota.`stock`, quota.`begin_time`, quota.`end_time` FROM tb_registration_pass rp LEFT JOIN tb_limited_registration_quota quota ON rp.id = quota.registration_pass_id WHERE rp.activity_id = #{activityId} AND rp.status = 1
